description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers, comparing four distinct combinations represented by different colored lines. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The red line, representing "en&en", starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.27 at layer 6, decreases to about 0.15 at layer 10, and then gradually declines to 0.07 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 22. The blue line, representing "en&es", begins at around 0.03 at layer 0, rises to about 0.25 at layer 6, drops to 0.15 at layer 8, and then decreases to 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to 0.37 at layer 22. The green line, representing "en&el", starts at approximately 0.02 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.14 at layer 6, decreases to about 0.08 at layer 8, and then gradually declines to 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.28 at layer 22. The purple line, representing "en&bn", begins at around 0.02 at layer 0, rises to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to 0.08 at layer 8, and then decreases to 0.04 at layer 20 before rising to 0.29 at layer 22.
